item_name: Rothco GI Type Y Style LC-1 Suspenders
item_short_desc: Bear the weight of your equipment with exceptional comfort and in military style with Rothco GI Type Y Style LC-1 Suspenders.
description: Bear the weight of your equipment with exceptional comfort and in military style with Rothco GI Type Y Style LC-1 Suspenders. These LC-1 suspenders function as a rugged load bearing harness supporting your All-Purpose Lightweight Individual Carrying Equipment (ALICE). These GI type suspenders are designed with a Y-shaped back and adjustable length shoulder straps allowing for a comfortable and secure fit and metal clips to attach to an equipment belt and butt pack. Our Y LC-1 suspenders are made to integrate with any field equipment. These ALICE pack suspenders are constructed with strong and lightweight polyester for reliable use.
